description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Aerid, adding {C}{C}.
When Aerid dies, it and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Aerid trigger, creating a Heartwood token.
Activate the Heartwood by tapping it, adding {R/G}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Aerid from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Nim Deathmantle to it,
When Aerid enters, it triggers, creating a Heartwood token.
Activate the Heartwood by tapping it, adding {R/G}.
Repeat.
